description: This file defines the json_config class used for inline inclusion of JSON-based server configuration in SuiteCRM, providing methods to retrieve app meta information, user config, focus data, and localized strings.

classes.name: json_config
classes.description: Class responsible for generating and providing JSON configuration snippets for SuiteCRM's client-side scripts, including app metadata, user info, and focus data.

methods.name: get_static_json_server
methods.description: Returns the combined JSON metadata, user settings, and optionally focus data and localized strings.

methods.name: getAppMetaJSON
methods.description: Creates JSON representation of application meta info, such as site URL.

methods.name: getUserConfigJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON with current user's theme, username, email, timezone, and other preferences.

methods.name: getFocusData
methods.description: Retrieves focus data for a specific module and record, encoding it in JSON.

methods.name: meeting_retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data about a specific meeting, including associated users and contacts.

methods.name: getStringsJSON
methods.description: Provides localized strings used by the calendar and meeting modules.

methods.name: populateBean
methods.description: Converts a focus bean into an array suitable for JSON encoding, filtering fields based on user permissions.

methods.name: listFilter
methods.description: Filters bean fields based on user access rights.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Returns the current user object, if available.
